commits.messageBody:
Each of #248-#251 left one comment asserting something measurably false — the
same defect class each of them spent dozens of lines eliminating in other
people's comments. The conclusions were all correct; only the reasons
overclaimed. This corrects the reasons and attaches to each the command that
discriminates it, so the next reader can refute the sentence instead of
trusting it.

  - web/src/lib<truncated 3331 chars>
